instruction: Configure VLC to automatically load subtitles from the Desktop folder

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VLC's subtitle autoload folder setting to Desktop. The evaluator checks if 'sub-autodetect-path' in vlcrc is set to '/home/user/Desktop'.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric comparison logic assumes 'sub-autodetect-path' contains a single path, but VLC stores this as a comma or semicolon-separated list of paths
The exact string match (line 26: current_path == expected_subtitle_path) will fail if Desktop path is combined with other paths (e.g., 'sub-autodetect-path=./subtitles,/home/user/Desktop')
No handling of VLC config formatting variations such as quotes, trailing slashes, or path list delimiters
The getter logic is correct and can extract the VLC config file properly
Expected value '/home/user/Desktop' is semantically correct for the instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change comparison from exact match to substring/list check: verify that '/home/user/Desktop' is contained within the sub-autodetect-path value
Parse the sub-autodetect-path value as a comma or semicolon-separated list and check if Desktop path is in the list
Normalize paths before comparison (handle trailing slashes, resolve ~/ to /home/user/)
Example fix: current_paths = [p.strip() for p in current_path.split(',')]; return 1.0 if expected_subtitle_path in current_paths else 0.0
